name: plasma_fire
title: Heavy plasma launcher

request.text: One isolated heavy science fiction plasma cannon shot. An immediate huge low-mid electromagnetic THWUMP with a vicious bright ion crack, thick tearing electrical texture and short descending resonant power tail. Powerful, physical and futuristic, cinematic game sound design. Centered punch with a wider electrical tail, clear initial transient. One shot at the start, then decay to silence. No charging introduction, thin cartoon pew, repeated shots, music, speech or ambient bed.

purpose: Private audition; not yet approved for game integration.
